instagram_carousel.caption:
A honeymoon tends to arrive in the busiest months of the year, when every spare evening goes to guest lists and suppliers.

A honeymoon planning service is one person who plans and books the trip for you: the flights, the stays and the days in between, all held in a single itinerary. Each piece comes with its own deposit, deadline and terms. The work is in keeping them in step.

What does not change? Your footing as a consumer. Australian consumer guarantees apply whether you book directly or through a planner.

Before you enquire, decide:
1. Dates, even roughly.
2. Length. Ten days and three weeks are very different trips.
3. Style. Still or moving, secluded or close to a little life in the evenings.
4. Must-haves. One or two each.
5. Pace of payment, before the first deposit is due.

Then ask any planner, including us: what is the fee and what does it cover, what does each booking include in writing, whose terms apply, do you hold insolvency insurance, what exchange rate sits behind an AUD quote, and do you receive commission from suppliers? Take out travel insurance early.

With Wedded Wonderland, you share your ideas, then meet your Wedded Advisor and agree the fee in writing before any work begins. One Wedded Advisor plans the trip start to finish, works in your time zone, quotes in AUD and confirms the inclusions in writing before you commit.

Send us a message to start the conversation. Full guide at the link in our bio.
